name: SummarizeVideo.ai
tagline: Summarize public video URLs and read their transcripts
description: Use SummarizeVideo.ai over Streamable HTTP to start a video summary, check its state, and read the finished Markdown summary or source transcript. Requires a SummarizeVideo.ai account and your own scoped agent key, sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. OAuth is not supported. New summaries use the account allowance: two free summaries per rolling 24 hours, or remaining Founding Pass credits. Read-only keys omit summarize_video. Read the setup at https://summarizevideo.ai/mcp-server

install.notes: Create your own scoped agent key at https://summarizevideo.ai/agent-keys. Replace <YOUR_AGENT_KEY> in your local client configuration before connecting. The placeholder is not a working credential. Never paste a key into a public listing or committed configuration. Keys can expire or be revoked. This listing does not provide automatic secret interpolation; see the setup documentation.
